{{infobox structure | title = Cauldron | image = Cauldron.png | appearance = Cauldron appearance.png | description = Crafting station | id = piece_cauldron | type = Crafting | skill = Cooking | source = [[Forge]] | usage = Cooking | durability = 100 | size = 1 x 1.4 x 1 | rain damage = no | materials = [[Tin]] x10 |resistances=cooking | support = wood }} The '''Cauldron''' is a crafting station used to prepare [[food]]. It requires a fire source underneath to operate, such as a [[Campfire]] or [[Hearth]]. == Building == Cauldrons can be placed using the [[Hammer]], found under the Crafting tab. A fire does not need to be present to place a Cauldron, only to use/craft with it. The Cauldron recipe is unlocked only when the player picks up [[Tin]] for the first time after smelting it and has a [[Forge]] built. == Upgrades == Upgrading a Cauldron enables additional crafting recipes.
